+def validate_capacity(proof, q):
+    require(proof.get('main_reviewed') is True and proof.get('passed') is True and
+            proof.get('complete') is True and proof.get('active') is False,
+            'new Main completed property receipt')
+    require(proof.get('single_block_request_bytes') == 1276953600 and
+            type(proof.get('single_block_request_bytes')) is int, 'exact cache512 single-block request')
+    for key in ('ze_max_mem_alloc_size', 'sycl_max_mem_alloc_size'):
+        require(type(proof.get(key)) is int and 1276953600 <= proof[key] <= (1 << 64) - 1, 'dual advertised max-allocation gate')
+    require(all(type(proof.get(key)) is int and proof[key] == 0 for key in
+                ('allocation_attempts', 'kernel_attempts', 'context_attempts', 'queue_attempts', 'copy_attempts')),
+            'property-only: no allocation/context/queue/copy/kernel')
+    require(proof.get('pci_bdf') == '0000:05:00.0' and proof.get('root_device') is True and
+            proof.get('vendor_id') == 0x8086 and type(proof.get('vendor_id')) is int and
+            type(proof.get('expected_native_device_id')) is int and
+            0 <= proof['expected_native_device_id'] <= 65535 and
+            type(proof.get('native_device_id')) is int and
+            proof['native_device_id'] == proof['expected_native_device_id'], 'exact Main native root identity')
+    require(proof.get('usm_device_allocations') is True and proof.get('relaxed_limits') in ('unset', '0') and
+            all(type(proof.get(key)) is int and proof[key] == 0 for key in
+                ('ze_status', 'ze_properties_status', 'sycl_properties_status')), 'successful normal-limit device-USM properties')
+    require(proof.get('compiler_provider') == 'installed-icpx-2026.1' and
+            proof.get('engine_binary') == q['binaries']['official'] and
+            proof.get('source_pins') == q['production_source_pins']['official'],
+            'unchanged official engine/source/provider binding')
+
+
+def cache_capacity(q):
+    require(type(q.get('cache_capacity_receipt')) is dict, 'cache capacity receipt required before launch')
+    proof = closed(load(identity(q['cache_capacity_receipt'])))
+    validate_capacity(proof, q)
+    require(proof.get('property_source') == {'path': str(HERE / 'health_caps.cpp'),
+                                           'sha256': sha(HERE / 'health_caps.cpp')}, 'exact property source')
+    binary = identity(proof['property_binary'])
+    require(str(binary) not in (pin['path'] for pin in q['binaries'].values()), 'distinct property-only helper')
+    require(proof.get('boot_id') == Path('/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id').read_text().strip(),
+            'sameboot property receipt')
+    from policy import environment
+    env = environment('official', False, q['engines']['official']['extra_runtime_dirs'])
+    expected = [str(binary), '0000:05:00.0', f"0x{proof['expected_native_device_id']:04x}"]
+    require(any(c.get('argv') == expected and c.get('environment') == env for c in proof['commands']),
+            'actual property command uses same explicit installed-provider environment')
+    return proof

+// SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 MistVVK and the XeStrata contributors
+// SPDX-License-Identifier: LGPL-3.0-or-later
+// Property-only sidecar. Main owns compilation and finite serialized execution.
+// No context/queue, USM allocation, transfer/kernel, recovery or relaxed-limit change.
+#include <sycl/sycl.hpp>
+#include <sycl/ext/oneapi/backend/level_zero.hpp>
+#include <level_zero/ze_api.h>
+#include <cstdint>
+#include <cstdlib>
+#include <iomanip>
+#include <iostream>
+#include <optional>
+#include <sstream>
+#include <stdexcept>
+#include <string>
+
+namespace {
+uint32_t expected_id(const std::string& text) {
+    if (text.size() != 6 || text[0] != '0' || text[1] != 'x')
+        throw std::runtime_error("expected native device ID must be exact 0xHHHH");
+    uint32_t value = 0;
+    for (size_t i = 2; i < text.size(); ++i) {
+        const char c = text[i];
+        uint32_t digit = 0;
+        if (c >= '0' && c <= '9') digit = static_cast<uint32_t>(c - '0');
+        else if (c >= 'a' && c <= 'f') digit = static_cast<uint32_t>(c - 'a') + 10;
+        else if (c >= 'A' && c <= 'F') digit = static_cast<uint32_t>(c - 'A') + 10;
+        else throw std::runtime_error("native device ID contains non-hex digit");
+        value = value * 16 + digit;
+    }
+    return value;
+}
+}  // namespace
+
+int main(int argc, char** argv) try {
+    if (argc != 3 || std::string(argv[1]) != "0000:05:00.0")
+        throw std::runtime_error("usage: health_caps 0000:05:00.0 <Main-identity-0xHHHH>");
+    const uint32_t requested_id = expected_id(argv[2]);
+    const char* relaxed = std::getenv("UR_L0_USE_RELAXED_ALLOCATION_LIMITS");
+    if (relaxed && std::string(relaxed) != "0")
+        throw std::runtime_error("normal-limit observation requires relaxed limits unset or0");
+    const std::string bdf = argv[1];
+    // No default selector: store the unique matching SYCL device, then query its SAME native handle.
+    std::optional<sycl::device> selected;
+    for (const auto& device : sycl::device::get_devices(sycl::info::device_type::gpu)) {
+        if (device.get_backend() != sycl::backend::ext_oneapi_level_zero) continue;
+        if (device.get_info<sycl::ext::intel::info::device::pci_address>() != bdf) continue;
+        if (selected) throw std::runtime_error("ambiguous PCI device");
+        selected.emplace(device);
+    }
+    if (!selected) throw std::runtime_error("required PCI device absent");
+    const auto native = sycl::get_native<sycl::backend::ext_oneapi_level_zero>(*selected);
+    const auto status = zeDeviceGetStatus(native);
+    if (status != ZE_RESULT_SUCCESS) throw std::runtime_error("zeDeviceGetStatus failed: " + std::to_string(static_cast<uint32_t>(status)));
+    ze_device_properties_t properties{};
+    properties.stype = ZE_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DEVICE_PROPERTIES;
+    properties.pNext = nullptr;
+    const auto property_status = zeDeviceGetProperties(native, &properties);
+    if (property_status != ZE_RESULT_SUCCESS) throw std::runtime_error("zeDeviceGetProperties failed: " + std::to_string(static_cast<uint32_t>(property_status)));
+    if (properties.type != ZE_DEVICE_TYPE_GPU || properties.vendorId != 0x8086 ||
+        properties.deviceId != requested_id || (properties.flags & ZE_DEVICE_PROPERTY_FLAG_SUBDEVICE) != 0)
+        throw std::runtime_error("ZE vendor/device/root identity refused");
+    const auto max_alloc = selected->get_info<sycl::info::device::max_mem_alloc_size>();
+    const auto global_mem = selected->get_info<sycl::info::device::global_mem_size>();
+    if (properties.maxMemAllocSize == 0 || max_alloc == 0 || global_mem == 0)
+        throw std::runtime_error("zero memory property refused");
+    const bool device_usm = selected->has(sycl::aspect::usm_device_allocations);
+    const bool host_usm = selected->has(sycl::aspect::usm_host_allocations);
+    const bool atomic_host_usm = selected->has(sycl::aspect::usm_atomic_host_allocations);
+    const bool shared_usm = selected->has(sycl::aspect::usm_shared_allocations);
+    const bool atomic_shared_usm = selected->has(sycl::aspect::usm_atomic_shared_allocations);
+    const bool system_usm = selected->has(sycl::aspect::usm_system_allocations);
+    // Emit only after EVERY query/check succeeded; no partial CAPS or per-device/library log.
+    std::ostringstream out;
+    out << "CAPS pci_bdf=" << bdf << " backend=level_zero vendor_id=0x8086 native_device_id=0x"
+        << std::hex << std::setw(4) << std::setfill('0') << properties.deviceId << std::dec
+        << " root_device=1 ze_status=" << static_cast<uint32_t>(status)
+        << " ze_properties_status=" << static_cast<uint32_t>(property_status)
+        << " sycl_properties_status=0 ze_max_mem_alloc_size=" << properties.maxMemAllocSize
+        << " sycl_max_mem_alloc_size=" << max_alloc << " sycl_global_mem_size=" << global_mem
+        << " usm_device_allocations=" << device_usm << " usm_host_allocations=" << host_usm
+        << " usm_atomic_host_allocations=" << atomic_host_usm << " usm_shared_allocations=" << shared_usm
+        << " usm_atomic_shared_allocations=" << atomic_shared_usm << " usm_system_allocations=" << system_usm
+        << " relaxed_limits=" << (relaxed ? "0" : "unset")
+        << " allocation_attempts=0 kernel_attempts=0 context_attempts=0 queue_attempts=0 copy_attempts=0";
+    const std::string line = out.str();
+    if (line.size() > 2048) throw std::runtime_error("CAPS line budget exceeded");
+    std::cout << line << '\n';
+    if (!std::cout) throw std::runtime_error("CAPS output failed");
+    return 0;
+} catch (const std::exception& error) {
+    std::cerr << "FAIL health_caps: " << error.what() << '\n';
+    return 1;
+} catch (...) {
+    std::cerr << "FAIL health_caps: unknown property failure\n";
+    return 1;
+}
